source_findings: Public instruction.md:7 and environment/instructions/ui.md require keyboard and narrow-screen usability and expressly permit one colour scheme.

Render gate criterion at tests/gates/render/judge.toml:25 requires entering source, pressing Run, and observing calculated preview and console output. Constraints criterion at tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-27 requires UI Save and clean-context retrieval.

Functional prompt S03 at tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:134-160 requires six-second idle intervals, real click, focused key/input, Stop and later click error. S04:163-182, S17:388-404, and S36:448-460 specify pending-timer, Auto-run debounce, and bounded callback observations.

Polish prompt at tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:43-51 requires actual keyboard-only route and events; responsive_layout at tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:23 requires reaching and using panes at roughly 390 by 844.

Visual prompt at tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:17-20,42-43 and responsive criterion at tests/scored/visual/judge.toml:99 require desktop/mobile comparison of same surfaces; a single theme is accepted.

counterexamples.broken_app: A first-paint mock with inert Run/Stop, dead preview handlers after five seconds, or controls hidden on a 390 by 844 viewport cannot satisfy the cited action, wait, and mobile observations.
counterexamples.conforming_alternative: A one-theme playground with responsive tabs or a scrolling single column, ordinary keyboard focus, and live handlers after idle satisfies the probes without a theme toggle or prescribed desktop pane geometry.

limit: These are source instructions and scripted reference observations, not evidence that the exact-current configured LLM judge actually followed them. The index explicitly reports no configured Oracle/Luna/visual Likert/full judge timing result.
